explained.summary: Don’t do things aimlessly. Every action should have a point, and it should be done properly, following sound principles the way a good craftsperson follows the rules of their trade. Marcus treats living well as a skill you practise, not something that happens by drifting.
explained.today: Before picking up your phone, opening another tab or agreeing to another meeting, ask what it’s actually for. If there’s no answer, that’s usually the sign to leave it.
